component: Accuracy & Learning / Evaluate Accuracy Button Hotfix

defects_remediated.summary: Nonfunctional Evaluate Accuracy button in Next Recommended Action and Accuracy & Learning tab
defects_remediated.root_cause: Button handler was hardcoded as setPrimaryTab('learning') with no API request or background job
defects_remediated.fix: Created POST /api/learning/rules/{rule_id}/evaluate-accuracy endpoint and wired handleEvaluateAccuracy in frontend

defects_remediated.summary: Misleading 'Evaluation Ready' banner when decisive evaluations = 0 and TP = 0
defects_remediated.root_cause: Next Recommended Action only checked total_analyst_reviews >= 30, ignoring 0 TP class balance deficit
defects_remediated.fix: Updated nextRecommendedAction to check class balance (TP >= 10, FP >= 10) and recommend 'Collect True Positive Ground Truth'

defects_remediated.summary: All-zero confusion matrix without explanation in Accuracy & Learning tab
defects_remediated.root_cause: Selective accuracy requires decisive predictions; 16 reviews resolved abstentions and 15 were initial benchmarks
defects_remediated.fix: Added comprehensive diagnostic alert and explanation under confusion matrix explaining non-decisive sample composition

defects_remediated.summary: Transient 0-review count glitch caused by shared promptRequestIdRef
defects_remediated.root_cause: fetchLearningProfile checked reqId !== promptRequestIdRef.current which was modified by concurrent fetchPrompt
defects_remediated.fix: Decoupled fetchLearningProfile and passed learningProfile directly to ReviewIncidentsWorkbench
